def girth(G):
    best = float('inf')
    for u in G.nodes():
        # BFS
        parent = {u: None}
        dist = {u: 0}
        queue = [u]
        for v in queue:
            for w in G.neighbors(v):
                if w not in dist:
                    dist[w] = dist[v] + 1
                    parent[w] = v
                    queue.append(w)
                elif parent[v] != w and parent[w] != v:
                    # found cycle
                    cycle_len = dist[v] + dist[w] + 1
                    if cycle_len < best:
                        best = cycle_len
    return best
